2026-08-26T17:58:44.8547703Z 1. Make any file changes directly in the working directory.

2026-08-26T17:58:44.8563611Z 6. After calling `create_pull_request`, STOP. Do not probe with another PR call, do not test auth with manual `git push`, and do not rewrite git remotes.

2026-08-26T17:58:44.8612267Z ```bash

2026-08-26T17:58:44.8616025Z   discussion-body.md \
2026-08-26T17:58:44.8616932Z   | safeoutputs update_discussion .
2026-08-26T17:58:44.8618872Z ```
2026-08-26T17:58:44.8621411Z `jq -Rs` reads the file as a raw string (`-R`) and slurps it into a single JSON string value (`-s`), so `body` is always a valid JSON field. Piping `cat file | safeoutputs ...` does not populate `body` and will be rejected.
